change: Data format v3 to v4: optional rules[].userId and users[].useSharedRules/usePersonalRules. Shared and personal label rules combine with OR; personal category rules take priority. Existing rules remain shared without rewriting their files. SQLite schema v1 and MTK1 encryption stay unchanged.
backup: Before upgrading v1/v2/v3 or unversioned data to v4, copy and verify the complete original data. Imports preserve the original source and verify copied files/history. No transaction conversion or existing rule rewrite is required.
downgrade: Versions 1.0.6 and 1.0.7 refuse v4 data. To downgrade, close the app and restore a complete compatible pre-upgrade backup with its original OS keyring. Earlier versions lack guards and must never open upgraded data.
